fast_domain.fibre_point:
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000 in
/-- PCUH: fresh (checked `index >>> 9#i32`) = gate (`wrapping_shr index 9#u32`): the shift amount is in range (PRVH.usize_shr9). -/
theorem PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.fibre_point : @NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.fibre_point = @NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point := by
  delta NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.fibre_point NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point
  simp only [PRVH.usize_shr9, PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.TABLE_A, PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.TABLE_B, PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.table_value, lift]
#print axioms PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.fibre_point
fast_domain.line_node:
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000 in
/-- PCUH: CONDITIONAL_ON_BINDING (the fresh namespace binds the external M31.ONE to the gate value, see NFN_prelude). -/
theorem PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.line_node : @NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.line_node = @NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.line_node := by
  delta NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.line_node NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.line_node NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.aspis_core.field.M31.ONE
  simp only [PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.fibre_point, bind_tc_ok]
#print axioms PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.fast_domain.line_node
verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body:
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000 in
/-- PCUH: fresh checked `index + 1` = gate `wrapping_add index 1` because `index < flat.len` on the only path that reaches it (PRVH.usize_add_one_of_lt). -/
theorem PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body : @NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body = @NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body := by
  funext flat prefixes product index
  delta NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body
  by_cases hlt : index < Slice.len flat
  · simp only [PRVH.usize_add_one_of_lt hlt, lift, bind_tc_ok]
  · simp [hlt]
#print axioms PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry_p2.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body
